'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan floods]]
**At least 68 people are killed by floods in [[Ghor Province|Ghor]] and [[Faryab Province|Faryab]] provinces, [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistanrain-flash-floods-death-toll-ghor-25a54bd187d29df8c8cbf6d63a7656c8 (AP)]
*Three people are killed and five others are injured in a boat collision on [[Bobs Lake (South Frontenac)|Bobs Lake]] in [[Ontario]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/ottawa/3-dead-5-injured-in-evening-boat-crash-north-of-kingston-1.7208950 (CBC News)]
*At least 23 migrants are missing after boarding a boat travelling from [[Tunisia]] to [[Italy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisia-says-23-migrants-missing-after-setting-off-boat-italy-2024-05-18/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Bishkek riots]]
**The [[Foreign Ministry of Pakistan]] asks that Pakistani nationals in [[Kyrgyzstan]] stay indoors after [[2024 Bishkek attacks|mob attacks]] on Pakistanis and other foreign nationals are reported. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Guardia di Finanza|Italian financial police]] seize 134 [[Fiat]] cars imported from [[Morocco]] following a dispute on stickers indicating the origin of the car. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/italian-police-seize-134-fiat-cars-flag-dispute-2024-05-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023–2024 Georgian protests]]
**[[President of Georgia]] [[Salome Zourabichvili]] vetoes the proposed "Law on Transparency of Foreign Influence". [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/18/georgia-president-vetoes-foreign-influence-law-protests (''The Guardian'')]
*[[LGBT rights in Peru]]
**Hundreds of protesters march in [[Lima]], [[Peru]], to demand the reversal of a new law that describes [[transgender]] people as having a mental illness. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-protesters-slam-new-insurance-law-that-deems-transgender-people-mentally-2024-05-18/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Communist Party of Vietnam]] nominates [[Minister of Public Security (Vietnam)|Minister of Public Security]] [[Tô Lâm]] as the next [[President of Vietnam|President]] after [[Võ Văn Thưởng]] resigned as President in March due to the party's [[Corruption in Vietnam#Government anti-corruption efforts|anti-corruption campaign]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/18/vietnam-nominates-public-security-minister-to-be-new-president (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 Bundesliga]]
**In [[association football]], [[Bundesliga]] champions [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen]] become the first Bundesliga team to finish a season [[List of unbeaten football club seasons|unbeaten]] after defeating [[FC Augsburg]] on the final matchday. [https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5503124/2024/05/18/bayer-leverkusen-undefeated-bundesliga/ (''The New York Times'')]

**In [[association football]], [[Chelsea F.C. Women]] wins their 7th [[Women's Super League]] title after defeating [[Manchester United W.F.C.]] 6–0 in the final match. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/chelsea-crowned-wsl-champions-after-crushing-man-united-2024-05-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tyson Fury vs Oleksandr Usyk]]
**In [[boxing]], [[Oleksandr Usyk]] defeats [[Tyson Fury]] by split decision and becomes the first undisputed four-belt heavyweight champion in history. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/boxing/articles/clwwl4pq092o (BBC Sport)]
